localChanges: With ?interface=new, the Happiness report (F4) has each city's citizens as faces, with how many are happy, content and unhappy beside them to sort by, a city in disorder in red and one celebrating in green. Click a city to see why its citizens feel as they do, under the table, or its View button to open it (closes #744).
With ?interface=new, Top Cities in the World (F8) is a table of each city's rank, owner, size, citizens and wonders, sortable by any of them, with a View button on your own cities.
